idx_reading_group_lists_list_id, idx_reading_group_lists_shared_by, idx_passkey_challenges_user_id
idx_kobo_reading_states_book_id, idx_ai_enrichments_book_id, idx_goodreads_metadata_book_id, idx_book_annotations_user_id

backlog.title: Parallelize batch DB queries in Kobo sync and OPDS handlers
backlog.description: HandleSync 4 sequential batch queries -> concurrent via sync.WaitGroup; OPDS bookEntries 2 sequential -> concurrent
backlog.impact: Reduces Kobo sync latency from sum-of-4-queries to max-of-4-queries
